examples.arabic: بابا كان بده يروح ع الجبل بس ماما فضلت البحر
examples.english: My dad wanted to go to the mountain but my mom preferred the sea.
examples.transliteration: baba kan biddo yrouh a aljabal bas mama faddalat albahr

examples.arabic: ماما قالت الثلاجة ما عم تشتغل منيح وهالوضع صار صعب
examples.english: Mom said the fridge isn't working well and this situation became difficult.
examples.transliteration: Mama qalat el tallajeh ma am tishtaghel mneeh w hal wada' sar sa'ab.

examples.arabic: صباح الخير ماما ليش لازم نفرشي اسناننا كل يوم قبل الفطور
examples.english: Good morning mom, why do we have to brush our teeth every day before breakfast?
examples.transliteration: Sabah el-kheir mama leish laazem nfarshi asnan-na kull yom qabel el-fatoor

examples.english: Good evening mom, how are you?

examples.arabic: انا و ماما بندور على الوصفة على الانترنت
examples.english: Me and mom are searching for the recipe on the internet.
examples.transliteration: Ana w mama binḍawwer 3ala il-waṣfeh 3ala il-internet.

examples.arabic: بالصباح بتسال ماما شو بدنا ناكل اليوم
examples.english: In the morning she asks mom "What do we want to eat today?"
examples.transliteration: Bil-sabah bit-tes'al mama "Shu badna nakul al-yawm?"
